basic_details.job_title: Mangaluru City Corporation Underground Drainage Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 45 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Mangaluru City Corporation has announced 45 vacancies for the Underground Drainage Assistant post on a contract basis under its 2026 recruitment drive. Eligible candidates can submit the offline application form by hand to the Mangaluru City Corporation Administration Branch on or before 28 October 2026 at 5:00 PM. Applicants must be able to speak Kannada and have been working as an Underground Drainage Assistant under outsourcing on or before 24 July 2026. content_sections.heading: Mangaluru City Corporation Underground Drainage Assistant at a Glance

rows.details: Must know how to speak Kannada with mandatory prior outsourcing experience as specified.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applicants must obtain the prescribed application form from the Mangaluru City Corporation Administration Branch and submit the filled form by hand along with the required documents to the same office on or before 28-10-2026 by 05:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational and Other Qualifications: There is no separate formal educational qualification prescribed. Candidates must know how to speak Kannada. Candidates must be working as Underground Drainage Assistant through outsourcing (excluding net wells/STP) and must have been working as such on or before 24-07-2026. Age Limit: Candidates must not exceed 55 years of age as of 24-07-2026.

content_sections.heading: Mangaluru City Corporation Underground Drainage Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: The post involves carrying out underground drainage assistance work on a contract basis within the limits of Mangaluru City Corporation.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Chalan obtained from the Corporation Accounts Branch showing remittance to the Corporation bank account (Canara Bank). Copies of SSLC / PUC or birth certificate / transfer certificate / voter ID / PAN card / driving licence or school transfer certificate showing date of birth. Labour Department Identity Card and Provident Fund (PF) documents in proof of service as Underground Drainage Assistant. Discharge certificate from military service for ex-servicemen candidates (if claiming reservation). Caste certificate in the prescribed format from the competent authority for Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Category-1, Category-2A, Category-2B, Category-3A, and Category-3B candidates (if claiming reservation). Rural candidate study certificate in Form-1 and Form-2 (if claiming reservation). Kannada medium study certificate from 1st to 10th standard (if claiming reservation). Disability certificate issued by the District Medical Board under the specified 2005 government notification (if claiming reservation). Project-displaced family certificate issued by the competent authority (if claiming reservation). Any other relevant supporting documents for claimed reservations.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is done through direct recruitment for vacancies allocated out of the 477 total posts (including 45 allocated to Mangaluru City Corporation) as per the Karnataka Municipal Corporations rules. The process involves scrutiny of applications submitted through offline mode by the competent authority, followed by document verification for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for the Underground Drainage Assistant post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 45 vacancies notified for the Underground Drainage Assistant post in Mangaluru City Corporation.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 28-10-2026 by 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the prescribed pay scale for this position?
faq.answer: The notified pay scale for the Underground Drainage Assistant post is 27000-46675.

faq.question: Q4. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Applicants must not exceed 55 years of age as of 24-07-2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for general candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for other (general) category candidates is Rs. 200/-.

faq.question: Q6. How should candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must obtain the application form from the Mangaluru City Corporation Administration Branch and submit the completed offline application by hand to the office along with fee chalan and documents.

faq.question: Q7. Who is eligible to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must be able to speak Kannada and have been working as an Underground Drainage Assistant under outsourcing on or before 24-07-2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is this recruitment on a regular or contract basis?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for filling up outsourced Underground Drainage Assistant positions on a direct recruitment basis under regularisation schemes as per government orders.

faq.question: Q9. What documents must be enclosed with the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must enclose the bank chalan receipt, age proof document, service proof documents such as labour ID and PF records, and relevant reservation certificates if applicable.
